business_problem: The Georgia Secretary of State needed reliable visibility into poll-pad patch levels and security across 159 counties, as well as a way to identify unknown assets and prioritize vulnerabilities with a small election-technology team.
solution_summary: The Georgia Secretary of State adopted Armis from ServiceNow for AI-powered asset intelligence and attack-surface protection. Armis passively discovers office and election-connected devices, including 10,000 poll pads, and provides visibility into patch levels, asset information, and potential vulnerabilities. The office integrated Armis with its mobile-device-management solution in under six weeks so it could validate device security before elections. Staff use Armis for patching reviews and asset verification, while AI-powered tools prioritize vulnerabilities and support remediation workflows. Armis also discovered and documented a previously unknown VLAN and helped the office consolidate point products. The source describes Armis as an AI-enabled asset-intelligence service but does not specify the models, network data architecture, or model-training process.
